title.narrative: Eswatini - Silele Community Project - Di Moody

description.narrative:
Summary: Working through the Baphalali Eswatini Red Cross' Clinic in Silele we are reaching the community through three elements – Water and Sanitation - Rehabilitation of the Water system for the Silele Clinic, Water Committees, Rain water Harvesting and water tank construction, Train BERCS staff in WASH, Hand washing facilities at schools and awareness, Demonstration HHs Menstrual Hygiene Management - Learning workshop with Malawi, Lesotho and Uganda RC, Parental support groups, Teen clubs training, making sanitary pads (potentially), Construct MHM friendly latrine at Silele Clinic, Awareness raising for PSEA Nutrition - Awareness raising on healthy eating and indigenous foods, Key hole gardens demonstration at Silele Clinic, Cooking demonstrations, Community Nutritional status database, Food supplements for mothers and children, Anthropometric kits for the Clinic Location: Silele Clinic and Community in the Shiselweni region Bens:

125 Red Cross Volunteers and Community-Based Health Workers as well as school teachers will be trained on water harvesting, ENA (Essential Nutrition Actions), key hole gardens, sexual reproductive health, and menstrual hygiene management. It is estimated that the final direct beneficiary count of the project will be more than 16,000 people; this number includes the school populations plus the all those registered at the clinic, and an estimate of walk in patients (given to us from Clinic stats)
Donors: Di Moody Legacy Fund - £175,000 PPL - £175,000 + £12,250 = £187,250 Finnish Red Cross - €55,000 (roughly £47K) Budget - £409,250 PNSs: Finnish Red Cross
